card.name: Inside scripture book names in citations
card.fires_on: Partway through the name of a scripture book or section, such as Surah, Parashat, Gemara, Exodus, Ezekiel or Psalms, right before a chapter and verse reference.

modes.label: Quran surah names
modes.description: The middle of the word Surah in a verse citation, before the surah name and verse number.

modes.label: Bible book abbreviations
modes.description: Inside an abbreviated or full Bible book name before chapter and verse numbers.

modes.label: Jewish text names
modes.description: Inside Torah portion or Talmud names such as Parsha or Gemara.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of the name of a Bible, Quran or Talmud book when a verse is being cited.
